messages:
incident-bot: Pager: PROD runtime queueing above SLO in hosted-prod-us-east. 95th latency ~3.8s (SLO 1.5s). Error rate increasing, a lot of long-running reranker calls. paging @sara

sara: On it — grabbing pager. Landing now. any immediate mitigations we should try?

raj: Sara — looks like the reranker FF rolled out this morning to 30% and KV cache eviction is thrashing. Reranker backend latency spikes are causing max-inflight stalls. If we flip the reranker flag off we should see load drop quickly.

sara: @raj can you flip the flag? I'll prepare rate-limit and queue changes as a guard. @kai can you weigh in on max_inflight/soft-shed tuning?

kai: I'm here. Recommend quick steps: 1) flip reranker FF off, 2) reduce global max_inflight (500 -> 240) to avoid long tail queue buildup, 3) introduce soft_shed=20% for low-tier traffic, 4) tighten per-customer burst qps to 10 for noisy tenants. Doing step 2 now.

eng-runtime-bot: Running config update:
```
./deploy-config --env prod --set max_inflight=240 --set soft_shed=0.2 --reason "live mitigation"
```

raj: Flipping reranker flag OFF: `/ff toggle reranker false --env prod --confirm`
raj: done — flag is off. Traffic to reranker backends dropped ~85% within 30s.

sara: Applying per-customer caps for top noisy customers (acct-42, acct-77, acct-99). Using rate-limiter API.

raj: Curl to update limiter: 
```
curl -X POST https://rl.redwood.prod/internal/limits -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' -d '{"acct":"acct-42","qps":10}'
```

eng-runtime-bot: Per-customer caps applied. Observability: 95th latency down to ~1.6s, error rate trending down. Still seeing a few tail spikes ~2.2s; monitoring for 10m.

maria: Customer impact summary: accounts A, B, C experienced increased 5xx and slow responses for ~15–25m. CS alerted, drafting customer note. No data loss.

sara: Good. Keeping this thread open until stable. If 95th < 1.5s for 15m we can close. Assigning postmortem owner: @raj.

raj: Opening incident ticket INCIDENT-2024-9874 and starting timeline. @maria please own customer comms. I'll pull logs and perf samples.

incident-bot: Mitigation in place — page resolved (:white_check_mark:). Suspected root cause: reranker rollout + non-eviction-friendly KV cache config causing memory pressure and long-running RPCs. Follow-ups: rollback rollout procedure, add preflight cache-behavior checks, and add a guard to block reranker spikes >20% of qps.

sara: Thanks team. Will schedule a quick Huddle with eng-runtime + infra to triage and turn this into a concise postmortem tomorrow.
